content: Snap v0.16.0 (May 2026, actively maintained, Elixir 1.16+) is the recommended Elasticsearch/OpenSearch client for Elixir. Features: versioned index management with zero-downtime alias swap, streaming bulk operations, connection pooling, Telemetry events, multi-search API. Config via Snap.Cluster module. elastix v0.10.0 is the older alternative but was last updated May 2021 and appears abandoned. elasticsearch-elixir by danielberkompas is another option but less maintained. Snap is the clear 2026 choice.
